items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject the new infrainnovator.com preview from this plan. Continue only existing measurement, repair, attribution, legal/security, parked-site, and finance reconciliation work. Amazon reported $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 under tracking_id 'other'; named site rows show clicks but $0 site-attributed commission, so site revenue is unsupported. AI spend was $916.91 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 39 instrumented sites, including $143.69 for 0daynews.com, $98.55 for americastrikes.com, and $66.06 for blackmarketapparel.com. Infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, experiment costs, commitments, and budget ceilings are missing; contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, forecasts, and cost-to-learn are therefore not calculable. SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating metrics, not financial outcomes. Minimum measurement: matching-period provider revenue identifiers by site/content; complete AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment ledger; budget ceilings and commitments; and an explicit cost-to-learn threshold. Do not treat missing data as zero or create new spend, telemetry, monetization, deployment, experiment, or requeue work.

Continue the existing allthingsmasonic.com homepage-refresh measurement record using existing telemetry only. The available evidence is 61 named Amazon clicks and $0 site-attributed commission; no revenue lift or margin benefit is established. Retain the deployment or recommend bounded rollback only from observed validation, without adding production scope or making financial claims.

Continue the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 as unattributed. Reconcile provider identifiers against recorded costs and document missing budget ceilings, commitments, and learning thresholds. Do not infer site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, forecasts, or causal lift.
